sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 133)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, Bill Adams as G.K. Chesterton's Father Brown in *The Blue Cross* produced by Himan Brown, Joseph Julian busting counterfeiters on *Call the Police* for Rinso, Spike Jones unleashing musical bedlam on *The Chase and Sanborn Program*, and three decades of *Guest Star* Treasury showcases featuring Ray Anthony, Jerry Gray, and Dick Haymes (1945–1962):
